title: FLA CFB writer emits an unsorted degenerate directory chain — violates MS-CFB red-black-tree name ordering; real Flash/OLE32 name lookup of 'Contents' can fail
description: packages/core/src/fla/write/cfb-write.ts writeDirectory:322-372 builds the directory as a degenerate linear chain (root.childId -> entry 1, each entry only rightSibling -> next, color always black) in Map insertion order (Media*, Symbol*, Page*, Contents LAST — see saveRealFla stream assembly order in write/fla-write.ts:31-138). [MS-CFB] 2.6.4 requires siblings to form a binary search tree ordered by name length then uppercase-name comparison; OLE32/MFC (what real Flash 8 uses to OpenStream) walks that tree comparatively. With the current chain, looking up 'Contents' (8 chars) at a node named 'Symbol 1' (8 chars, 'CONTENTS' < 'SYMBOL 1') directs the walk LEFT where leftSibling is NOSTREAM => stream not found, so a real Flash 8 / any strict CFB consumer may fail to open a dash-saved FLA that contains at least one symbol. Our own reader (ole.ts collectStreamEntries:245-269) visits ALL siblings regardless of order, so every in-repo round-trip test passes and the defect is invisible. STATUS: verified against the MS-CFB spec; UNCONFIRMED against a real Flash 8 install (no oracle in repo) — but the writer's stated contract is byte/structural compatibility with real Flash, and this is the kind of structural break that torpedoes it wholesale. Fix: sort directory entries by the CFB name ordering (length, then uppercase UTF-16 compare) and emit a valid BST (a balanced tree or at minimum a sorted right-spine is a valid BST only if every lookup path stays correct — prefer building a proper balanced red-black/AVL-ish tree the way python olefile/compoundfiles do). Acceptance: (a) unit test asserting the emitted directory satisfies the MS-CFB sibling-ordering invariant and that a BST-style name lookup (walk left/right by the CFB comparator, no exhaustive scan) finds every stream incl. 'Contents' in a doc with symbols+media; (b) cross-check readback with tools/flashdrv/fla_cfb.py; (c) existing cfb-write-difat + round-trip suites stay green.
